description: This is a Java test class for integration testing the Group Savings feature in the Apache Fineract platform. It includes multiple test cases simulating user interactions such as creating clients, groups, savings accounts, applying for savings, depositing, withdrawing, charging, and managing the status of savings accounts, including special operations like GSIM (Group Savings and Investment Management) accounts.

classes.name: GroupSavingsIntegrationTest
classes.description: This is a JUnit 5 integration test class for the Group Savings feature in Apache Fineract. It contains multiple test methods that cover creating, approving, activating, closing, rejecting, and managing savings accounts including GSIM accounts, along with transaction and charge operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount
methods.description: Tests the complete lifecycle of a group savings account, including creation, approval, activation, interest calculation, posting, and interest retrieval.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_CLOSE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests closing a savings account, verifying validation when balance is not zero, and successful closure.

methods.name: testGsimSavingsAccount_WithTwoClients_ChildCountTwo
methods.description: Tests creating a GSIM account with two clients (parent and child) and verifies the child account count.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_DELETE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests deleting a savings application after approval and submitting proper error handling.

methods.name: testGsimSavingsAccount_REJECT_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests the rejection process of a GSIM savings application, including various validation errors.

methods.name: testGsimSavingsAccount_DEPOSIT_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests depositing funds into a GSIM account after application approval.

methods.name: testGsimSavingsAccount_CLOSE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests closing a GSIM savings account after approval, with validation for non-zero balance.

methods.name: testGsimSavingsAccount_UPDATE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests updating a GSIM application with new details.

methods.name: getGsimAccount
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM accounts associated with a group.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a new savings product with specified configurations.

methods.name: clientArray
methods.description: Constructs a map representing client details for savings applications, including parent status.

methods.name: savingsArray
methods.description: Constructs a map representing a savings transaction for deposit or withdrawal.
